provenance.preservation: Exact supplied JPEG bytes copied without additional transcoding, rotation, cropping, or modification

visibleEvidence: registered exterior silhouette and internal boundary constellation

corpusRole.variation: real physical-target capture with perspective, distance, and scale variation
corpusRole.targetFrameOccupancy: target occupies a substantially smaller portion of the photograph
corpusRole.toleranceEligibility: Eligible for empirical perspective, scale, and physical-camera registration measurements after the governed backend measurement procedure is approved.

governance.notes: Preserve as an additive perspective/scale positive fixture. All earlier positive and negative fixtures remain authoritative evidence for their assigned corpus roles.
